Solutions
K9 Search & Rescue
Log SAR training, deployments, and certifications across every discipline, including air scent, trailing, HRD, disaster, water, and avalanche.
Law Enforcement & Government K9
Log training, deployments, certifications, and use-of-force documentation across law enforcement, military, government, and border K9 programs.
Detection & Scent Work
Log detection sessions, track indication quality and reliability, and see performance patterns across every discipline, including narcotics, explosives, conservation, agriculture, bio-detection, arson, and bed bug inspection.
Dog Sport Teams
Track training, progression, and competition readiness across every discipline, including PSA, IGP, Ring, agility, dock diving, scent work, rally, and all working and performance sports.
Professional K9 Trainers
Structured documentation for solo trainers, group coaches, academies, behavioral specialists, seminars, and evaluators, from session logs to client-facing progress reports.
Protection & Private Security K9
Structured training records, deployment logs, and liability documentation for personal protection trainers, private security companies, executive protection details, and sport-to-work programs.
Service Dog Programs
Training documentation, placement readiness, and program oversight for service dog, therapy, assistance, medical alert, and private training programs.
Dog Kennels & Breeding Programs
Complete training, health, and placement records for every dog from first evaluation to final sale. Built for LE/military suppliers, import kennels, breeding programs, hunting kennels, and boarding facilities.
